rav-shmuel-bar-rav-yitzchak.name: Rav Shmuel bar Rav Yitzḥak
rav-shmuel-bar-rav-yitzchak.bio: Amora and student of Rav Huna; the Talmud (Ketubot 17a) tells that he would dance before brides juggling three myrtle branches.
rav-shmuel-bar-rav-yitzchak.prompt: A joyful elderly scholar in his 70s with a long white beard and a broad smile, in a white linen robe, holding three green myrtle branches aloft as if about to dance. A lamp-lit wedding courtyard softly behind him.

rav-chinnana.name: Rav Ḥinnana
rav-chinnana.bio: Amora who transmits a teaching of Rav.
rav-chinnana.prompt: A careful Babylonian scholar in his 50s with a greying dark beard and an attentive look, in a plain brown wool robe and a cream mantle. Mudbrick academy walls and oil lamps behind him.

rav-huna-brei-derav-yehoshua.name: Rav Huna, son of Rav Yehoshua
rav-huna-brei-derav-yehoshua.bio: Babylonian Amora, a student of Rava and the constant study companion of Rav Pappa.
rav-huna-brei-derav-yehoshua.prompt: A prosperous Babylonian scholar in his 40s with a neat dark beard and a thoughtful expression, his head covered with a wrapped cloth, in a fine dark green robe. A Babylonian study hall with palm trees beyond its archway.
